title: Camera Inspections in San Antonio, TX
desc: Looking to have a video sewer line inspection in San Antonio, TX? Rosenberg Plumbing & Air provides expert camera inspections. Call us today!

blocks.text: Many homes in San Antonio were built in the 1960s, and have galvanized sewers that are vulnerable to corrosion. Shifting soil, growing tree roots, and the ravages of time all combine to cause leaks or blockages in your sewers.
Rosenberg Plumbing & Air offers camera inspections in San Antonio, TX, helping track down damaged sections of pipework, and determine the most efficient way to repair them.

When a pipe that’s underground or behind a wall becomes damaged, it can be difficult to pinpoint the leak. Video sewer line inspection is just one of the diagnostic methods our plumbers can use to locate collapsed, obstructed or damaged pipes, helping identify areas for repair.

blocks.text: Our plumbers use state-of-the-art cameras to inspect your pipes from the inside, so they can see not only exactly where the damage is, but what the overall condition of the pipes is. Armed with this information, they can advise you on whether repiping would make sense, and give you an idea of whether you’re likely to have other problems with your pipes in the near future.

In some cases, tree root incursion or shifting foundation can cause extensive damage to underground pipes, making smaller repairs uneconomical in the long term. Investing in a video sewer line inspection can give you some idea of whether more than one section of the pipes outside your home is damaged, so you can make an informed decision about how to proceed with repairs.
